note: Direct 'add to my to do list' -> task auto-consents
transcript: I need to sweep the floor, add that to my to do list.

note: Plain statement of intent -> NO consent
transcript: I need to sweep the floor at some point today.

note: Direct 'add to Google calendar for 5pm' -> calendar auto-consents
transcript: I need to sweep the floor, add that to Google calendar for 5pm.

note: Mentioning an appointment is not a command
transcript: I'm seeing the dentist tomorrow at 3pm, hope it goes quickly.

note: Mixed: one commanded task + one uncommanded task
transcript: Put water the plants on my task list. Also I should probably call the plumber sometime.

note: 'Remind me to' counts as an instruction to log it
transcript: Remind me to take out the trash tonight.

note: 'Don't add that yet' negates the command
transcript: I might repaint the fence this weekend but don't add that to my list yet.

note: 'Look that up for me' -> search auto-consents
transcript: Who designed the Concorde? Look that up for me.

note: Passing curiosity is not a search command
transcript: I wonder what the average lifespan of a housecat is.

note: Command applies to its own item only, not neighbors
transcript: Add buy groceries to my to do list. I also really need to renew my passport soon.

note: 'Schedule it' phrasing without naming the app still consents
transcript: Dinner with Sam on Friday at 7pm, go ahead and schedule it.

note: Command but vague details -> still uncertain, so no auto-exec (grader checks both flags)
transcript: Add lunch with Priya to my calendar, sometime next week I guess.
